recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the approved FHIR-25226 correction across the active core search-page and search-modifier-code source surfaces without reopening settled Identifier.type search behavior or duplicating separate FHIR-35812/FHIR-32673 audit commits.
issue_request: FHIR-25226 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core search-page issue for R5. It asked the token `:text` modifier description, which already named CodeableConcept.text, Coding.display, and Identifier.type.text, to also include Identifier.type.coding.display for consistency.
initial_application: No direct Jira-tagged source commit was found for FHIR-25226, and a pickaxe search found no prior Identifier.type.coding.display application in the active search sources. Before this reconciliation, source/search.html and source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml included Identifier.type.text plus later Identifier.assigner.display and Reference.display context, but still omitted Identifier.type.coding.display from each parallel `:text` and `:text-advanced` definition.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread confirms the omission was not intentional: Paul Church asked why Identifier.type.coding.display was omitted and Grahame Grieve replied that it had simply not been considered. FHIR-31708 later resolved no-change because Identifier.type `:text` matching was established normative behavior. FHIR-35812 and FHIR-32673 are already represented on the combined branch and support keeping Identifier-related `:text` and `:text-advanced` target examples aligned.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html in the token/reference `:text` summary row, detailed `:text` prose, `:text-advanced` summary row, and detailed `:text-advanced` prose. Updated source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml so the active `text` and `text-advanced` concepts also list Identifier.type.coding.display.
source_changes: source/search.html: added Identifier.type.coding.display to `:text` and `:text-advanced` examples in the modifier summary table and detailed sections.
source/searchparameter/codesystem-search-modifier-code.xml: added Identifier.type.coding.display to the `text` and `text-advanced` search modifier concept definitions.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive with Modification issue clarified Identifier-related `:text` targets and is already represented on the combined branch; this commit applies the older Identifier.type.coding.display point that still remained omitted.
Resolved - No Change issue concluded Identifier.type behavior for `:text` was established normative behavior, supporting documentation rather than removal.
Defined `:text-advanced` as the advanced text-processing counterpart to token `:text`, so the target-text examples should stay aligned.
